# Fixture for the internal/build Railpack integration: enough for
# Railpack's python provider to detect and successfully plan an app (so
# generateRailpackPlan gets a real, Success: true result), while python
# is still outside this slice's supportedRailpackProviders (node, golang
# only). This exercises UnsupportedProviderError's actual path, not a
# "Railpack could not plan the app at all" failure, which is what an
# empty/marker-less directory produces instead (see the earlier failed
# attempt this comment replaces: a bare README.md fixture surfaced as a
# generic build-plan failure, not an unsupported-provider one, because
# Railpack hard-fails ValidatePlan when no provider matches anything at
# all, rather than returning Success: true with an empty provider name).
flask==3.0.0
